Class.name: IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.File.Operation.LftpFile
Class.Description: Accepts objects of type Ens.StreamContainer and saves the encapsulated stream data to a file using the File OutboundAdapter.

Property.name: SuccessEmailSubject
Property.Description: This is the subject to use on the success email Email Identifier - "%FN-FileName,%CD-CurrentDate,%CT-CurrentTime"

Property.name: SucessEmailBody
Property.Description: Email This is the body that will be included in the success email Email Identifier - "%FN-FileName,%CD-CurrentDate,%CT-CurrentTime"

Property.name: FailureEmailSubject
Property.Description: This is the subject to use on the failure email Email Identifier - "%FN-FileName,%CD-CurrentDate,%CT-CurrentTime"

Property.name: FailureEmailBody
Property.Description: Email This is the body that will be included in the failure email Email Identifier - "%FN-FileName,%CD-CurrentDate,%CT-CurrentTime"

Property.name: valueToBeReplaced
Property.Description: Property to store the values to be replaced

Property.name: TargetFilePath
Property.Description:
Name of file to output the document(s) to. May include timestamp specifiers. The %f specifier if present will be replaced with the name of the document's original source filename (stripped of characters illegal in target filenames).

See the method Ens.Util.File.CreateTimestamp() for documentation of timestamping options.

Parameter.name: SETTINGS
Parameter.Default: Host:Basic, TargetFilePath:Basic, TargetFileName:Basic, Credentials:Additional, LftpCmd:Additional, STDOUT:Additional, STDERR:Additional,SuccessEmailSubject:Additional, SucessEmailBody:Additional,FailureEmailSubject:Additional, FailureEmailBody:Additional

Method.name: OnMessage
EnQueueToService
Method.Implementation: Set tSC = ##class(Ens.MessageHeader).NewRequestMessage(.pNewHeader,pRequest,pOriginalHeader.SessionId) Quit:$$$ISERR(tSC) tSC Set pNewHeader.CorrespondingMessageId = pOriginalHeader.%Id() Set pNewHeader.SourceConfigName = pOriginalHeader.TargetConfigName Set pNewHeader.TargetConfigName = $P(pTargetQueueName,":") Set pNewHeader.SourceBusinessType = $$$eHostTypeOperation Set pNewHeader.TargetBusinessType = $$$eHostTypeService Set pNewHeader.TargetQueueName = pTargetQueueName Set pNewHeader.Description = pDescription Quit ##class(Ens.Queue).EnQueue(pNewHeader)

Method.name: OnGetConnections
Method.Description: Return an array of connections for drawing lines on the config diagram

Method.name: replaceWithParticularFormat
Method.Implementation: Set key = "" For { Set ReplaceVal = ..valueToBeReplaced.GetNext(.key) Set SubBody = $REPLACE(SubBody,key,ReplaceVal) Quit:key="" } $$$TRACE("Done with replacement") Quit SubBody
